mapper.select: select line_id, factory_id, apply_id, external_line_id, sales_order_line_id, item_id, item_code, item_name, unit_of_measure, unit_name, apply_qty, posted_qty, line_status, remark, create_time, update_time from qxx_wm_sales_apply_line where apply_id = #{applyId} and factory_id = #{factoryId} order by line_id
mapper.insert: insert into qxx_wm_sales_apply_line (apply_id, external_line_id, sales_order_line_id, item_id, item_code, item_name, unit_of_measure, unit_name, apply_qty, posted_qty, line_status, remark, create_time) values (#{applyId}, #{externalLineId}, #{salesOrderLineId}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{unitOfMeasure}, #{unitName}, #{applyQty}, #{postedQty}, #{lineStatus}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
